task_instance: Fine-tune a small SentenceTransformer bi-encoder (e.g. a MiniLM-family base model) on a tiny sentence-pair similarity dataset, following the skill's production template (baseline eval, smoke-test, VERDICT line, try/except Hub push).
blocker_detail: The skill's entire workflow depends on huggingface.co (downloading a pretrained base checkpoint via SentenceTransformer/AutoModel, downloading a training dataset via `datasets`, and the mandatory end-of-run `model.push_to_hub(...)` step). The sandbox's egress proxy explicitly denies this host: `curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status` shows repeated `connect_rejected` entries for huggingface.co ('gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)'), and the proxy README states such 403/407 policy denials must not be retried or routed around. Attempting `models.Transformer('bert-base-uncased')` (equivalent to loading any real base model) failed with: "We couldn't connect to 'https://huggingface.co' to load the files, and couldn't find them in the cached files." Only pypi.org/files.pythonhosted.org (and a few other allowlisted hosts) are reachable, and no pretrained sentence-transformers/transformers checkpoints or datasets are available via pypi, so there is no workaround inside the allowed egress policy. This blocks both ends of the pipeline: loading the base model/dataset at the start, and the required Hub push at the end.
evidence: Installed sentence-transformers[train]>=5.0 successfully (after clearing disk space, which was separately nearly exhausted): `pip install --no-cache-dir "sentence-transformers[train]>=5.0"` succeeded, torch 2.14.0+cu130 and sentence-transformers 6.1.0 importable. Verified HF Hub reachability: `HfApi().model_info('sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2')` raised `403 Forbidden`. Checked proxy status (`curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status`): recentRelayFailures repeatedly show `connect_rejected` / 403 for host `huggingface.co:443` and `download.pytorch.org:443`; noProxy allowlist only includes pypi/npm/anthropic/crates/go-proxy domains, not huggingface.co. Directly attempted `sentence_transformers.models.Transformer('bert-base-uncased', ...)` (with HF_HUB_OFFLINE unset first, then confirmed with offline flags too) which raised OSError: "We couldn't connect to 'https://huggingface.co' to load the files, and couldn't find them in the cached files." No local/cached pretrained checkpoint exists to substitute, and no listed skill/tool provides an alternate mirror. Because obtaining a real pretrained embedding base model (or a real training dataset, or performing the required Hub push) is impossible under this runtime's fixed egress policy, the skill's actual training deliverable could not be produced or verified end-to-end.
